name: Alvimopan after radical cystectomy
question: Does perioperative alvimopan accelerate gastrointestinal recovery compared with placebo after radical cystectomy?

design.population: Patients undergoing radical cystectomy who were scheduled to receive postoperative intravenous opioid patient-controlled analgesia.
design.locator: Full text, Methods, pp 266-267; Fig. 1; Table 1

verdictNote: GI-2 recovery was faster in the 277-patient modified intention-to-treat analysis.
takeaway: In the modified intention-to-treat analysis after radical cystectomy, oral alvimopan versus placebo shortened Kaplan–Meier mean GI-2 recovery (5.5 versus 6.8 days; HR 1.773, 95% CI 1.4-2.3; p < 0.0001) and mean hospital stay (7.44 versus 10.07 days).

reports.label: Economic analysis
reports.citation: Kauf TL, Svatek RS, Amiel G, et al. "Alvimopan, a peripherally acting μ-opioid receptor antagonist, is associated with reduced costs after radical cystectomy: economic analysis of a phase 4 randomized, controlled trial." *J Urol.* 2014;191(6):1721-1727. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2013.12.015
reports.followUp: Protocol hospitalization and follow-up (mean 30 ± 7 days after discharge; mean total study time 43 days)

results.measure: Mean postoperative ileus-related cost per patient during protocol hospitalization plus follow-up, 2012 USD; alvimopan minus placebo difference
results.note: Preplanned hospital-perspective cost-consequence analysis; difference calculated before rounding, with 95% CI and P value from 10,000-iteration bootstrap. No prespecified economic endpoint threshold is reported.
results.locator: Full text, Methods, pp 1722-1723; Tables 4-5, pp 1724-1725

results.measure: Mean total combined cost per patient during protocol hospitalization plus follow-up, 2012 USD; alvimopan minus placebo difference
results.note: Includes postoperative ileus-related and other costs; difference calculated before rounding. Bootstrap P value exceeded 0.05; no prespecified economic endpoint threshold is reported.
results.locator: Full text, Methods, pp 1722-1723; Tables 4-5, pp 1724-1725

results.endpoint: Total combined costs during protocol hospitalization
results.measure: Mean total combined cost per patient during index hospitalization, 2012 USD; alvimopan minus placebo difference
results.note: Preplanned hospital-perspective cost-consequence analysis; 10,000-iteration bootstrap interval and P value. Difference calculated before rounding; no prespecified economic endpoint threshold is reported.
results.locator: Full text, Methods, pp 1722-1723; Table 5, p 1725

delivery.label: Total hospital days in economic analysis
delivery.locator: Full text, Methods, p 1722; Table 3, p 1724
delivery.note: From surgery through discharge-order day, counting surgery as day 1; one day longer than postoperative length of stay in the clinical report. P = 0.005.

delivery.label: Study medication received
delivery.locator: Full text, Methods, p 1722; Table 3, p 1724
delivery.note: Oral 12 mg alvimopan or placebo 30 minutes to 5 hours before surgery, then twice daily from postoperative day 1 until discharge or at most 7 inpatient days.

delivery.note: Patients with at least one postoperative nasogastric tube procedure; excludes tubes placed during surgery. P < 0.001 for both periods.

delivery.label: Total parenteral nutrition use
delivery.note: P = 0.001; percentages reported without event counts.

reports.label: Primary clinical report
reports.citation: Lee CT, Chang SS, Kamat AM, et al. "Alvimopan accelerates gastrointestinal recovery after radical cystectomy: a multicenter randomized placebo-controlled trial." *Eur Urol.* 2014;66(2):265-272. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2014.02.036

reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Methods, pp 266-267; Results, p 268

results.measure: Time to both first solid-food tolerance and first bowel movement, days
results.note: Kaplan-Meier mean, with 10-day observation censoring; 12% versus 25% did not achieve GI-2 before discharge or day 10. Three placebo patients were excluded from MITT.
results.locator: Full text, Results, p 267; Table 2 and note, p 269; Fig. 1

results.measure: Kaplan-Meier mean time from end of surgery to discharge order, days; censored at 10 days
results.note: Second endpoint in the prespecified sequential testing order; 11% versus 27% were censored before discharge or day 10.
results.locator: Full text, Methods, pp 266-267; Results, p 267; Table 2 and note, p 269

results.measure: Mean postoperative hospital length of stay, days; mean difference in days
results.note: Third endpoint in the prespecified sequential testing order; difference in days, alvimopan minus placebo, as reported in Table 2.
results.locator: Full text, Methods, pp 266-267; Table 2, p 269

results.measure: Patients with postoperative ileus-related morbidity; risk difference in percentage points
results.note: Fourth endpoint in the prespecified sequential testing order; includes nasogastric tube insertion (7.7% versus 24.6%), prolonged stay due to ileus, or ileus readmission within 7 days (one patient per arm).
results.locator: Full text, Methods, p 266; Results, pp 267-268; Table 2, p 269; Fig. 3, p 270

delivery.label: Assigned oral dose
delivery.note: One dose 30 minutes to 5 hours before surgery, then twice daily until discharge or 7 days; maximum 15 inpatient doses. Both arms had ambulation encouraged on postoperative day 1, liquids offered on day 3, solids on day 4, no epidural analgesia, and at most two opioid-sparing NSAID doses.

delivery.label: Surgical approach and operative duration
delivery.note: Among 21 high-volume academic sites; urinary diversion types differed between arms.
